title: Materialize StabilityMatrix current-host adapter, real model inventory scan and read-only cross-provider discovery evidence
decisions: The existing Model Manager authority boundaries remain unchanged; this materialization is an implementation/evidence extension only.
StabilityMatrix is scanned through its real current-host library and Models directory without replacing its own model management.
The StabilityMatrix scan enumerates recognized model artifacts, emits only relative paths, fingerprints the store root, and hashes a real representative artifact with full SHA-256.
The collector proves no structural StabilityMatrix model-store mutation by requiring identical before/after inventory manifests.
Cross-provider discovery reads StabilityMatrix, local Hugging Face immutable snapshots, the LM Studio local catalog, and Ollama native manifests without downloads or network access.
Discovery PASS does not canonically admit every observed model, infer compatibility, perform physical deduplication, choose model routing, or place workloads.
Executable current-host PASS may only be produced by the self-hosted fa3-current-host runner and is distinct from GitHub-hosted canonical regression PASS.
